title: Semi-Lagrangian Discontinuous Galerkin Method with Adaptive Mesh Refinement for the Vlasov--Poisson System in 1X+3V
summary: We extend the semi-Lagrangian discontinuous Galerkin (SLDG) method of Einkemmer to velocity grids with adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) and to three-dimensional velocity space. The original SLDG formulation assumes uniform cell widths, which permits the overlap matrices to be precomputed once per fractional shift and reused for every cell. On an adaptively refined mesh, neighboring cells may differ in size, invalidating this assumption.
